request.spec: Exports taken while a preview date is set use the preview figures.
request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read AGENTS.md — it states the working rules and how the app is tested, and sends you to
DESIGN.md for the app's stack and conventions. Follow both.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
Exports taken while a preview date is set use the preview figures.

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, test data and any audit
records it expects — match them. Run `bin/e2e` to build the app, start it, and run the test as

agent.result_text:
The people and claims exports now use the preview figures while a preview date is set. `bin/e2e` passes all 4 tests.

**What was wrong:** the export code already used the preview date in its figures. The problem was timing. Setting or clearing a preview makes the screen re-read the sheet, and it empties the people and claims lists first. An export clicked during that re-read wrote an empty file: the test got just the header line instead of `Ada,A,,11.00`.

**The fix** is all in `src/main/frontend/src/app/features/people/people-list.ts`:
- The screen now remembers its latest re-read of the sheet.
- "Export people" and "Export claims" wait for that re-read to finish before building the file. If another re-read starts meanwhile, they wait for that one too.
- So an export taken right after setting a preview has the preview figures. One taken right after clearing it has the normal figures.

No server, data or audit changes were needed. I didn't change the pools export, which has no due figures and isn't part of this test.
